events.description: ‫‫تبذل لولا، المرأة القوية والزوجة والأم لأربعة أطفال، قصارى جهدها للحفاظ على تضافر عائلتها، بينما تواجه العديد من الصعوبات الاجتماعية والمالية.‬‬
events.title: عائلتي

events.description: ‫‫تربط مجموعة من الحيوانات والحشرات علاقة صداقة قوية، إذ يخوض جميعهم مغامرات شيقة وممتعة في الغابة بالقرب من البحيرة الخضراء ويتعلمون الكثير.‬‬
events.title: حكايات في الأدغال

events.description: ‫‫تستخدم شميشة شافاي، وهي طاهية مغربية شهيرة، خبرتها ومعرفتها الواسعة لإعداد تشكيلة واسعة من الأطباق المحلية الشهية، وتقدم وصفة مفصلة لكل منها.‬‬
events.title: شهيوة مع شميشة

events.description: ‫‫الرحلة المروعة والمليئة بالصمود لنفس، وهي شابة تم بيعها لتزويجها في سن السادسة عشرة لرجل أعمال ثري ومضطرب نفسيا على مدار ثماني سنوات، تعيش نفس كابوسا من العنف المنزلي والأسر.‬‬
events.title: بحر الظلام

events.description: ‫م1 ، ح8 : ‫ينشيء ماكس غراهام وأصدقاؤه شركة تركز على التكنولوجيا المتقدمة، ويعتمدون على بعضهم لابتكار اختراعات رائدة تجذب المستثمرين.‬‬

events.description: ‫‫تعتني الفتاة الصغيرة الفضولية نسمة بمقتنياتها جيدا. تزداد الأمور حماسا عندما تخرج مخلوقات صغيرة من المقتنيات وتقرر مصادقتها.‬‬
events.title: إغ إينجلز كوكوتاما

events.description: ‫يتحول الصحفي شينجي كيدو، الذي يلاحق قضية ما، إلى كامين رايدر أي الدراج المقنع بفضل قوة مجموعة بطاقات يكتشفها أثناء تغطيته الإخبارية. سرعان ما ينجرف إلى عالم المرايا، حيث يكتشف أمر القضية. بينما يقاتل الوحوش لحماية الناس، ينخرط في صراع بين الدراجين.‬

data.title: قناة الإمارات

data.description: قناة الشارقة هي قناة تلفزيونية إماراتية مملوكة لهيئة الشارقة للإذاعة والتلفزيون، التابعة لإمارة الشارقة.

events.description: ‫‫يسلط فريق التقديم الضوء على الثقتفة والإرث التاريخي الموجود في إمارة الشارقة، كما ويدعو عددا من المواطنين من أجل إظهار مواهبهم.‬‬
events.title: أماسي

events.description: ‫‫يقوم فريق التقديم باستعراض آخر المستجدات والأخبار الراهنة، بالإضافة إلى تقارير مفصلة وأحداث من جميع أنحاء العالم.‬‬
events.title: الأخبار

events.description: ‫‫تتحدث شخصيات بارزة عن عدة فعاليات ثقافية المقامة في إمارة الشارقة، وتسلط الضوء على مواهب إماراتية وعربية.‬‬
events.title: لغة وأدب وفن

events.description: ‫‫يدعو المضيف علماء دين لتفسير العديد من آيات القرآن الكريم باستخدام نظريات علمية، لمساعدة المسلمين لزيادة معرفهم وتنظيم حياتهم.‬‬
events.title: في رحاب سورة

events.description: ‫‫يقدم أخصائيو صحة وأطباء نصائح صحية حول مختلف المشكلات، ويثقفون المشاهدين حول كيفية التعامل مع الإصابات والحالات الطارئة.‬‬
events.title: نصيحة طبيب

events.description: ‫‫يعيش شخص يدعى طرزان في الغابة، فيخوض مغامرات عديدة مع رفاقه بينما يحاولون الحفاظ على حياتهم من الحيوانات الشرسة.‬‬
events.title: طرزان

data.title: آسيانت سينما

data.description: وجهة سينمائية مالايالامية متخصّصة تقدّم مجموعة مختارة من الأفلام الكلاسيكية والحديثة، إلى جانب أبرز الإنتاجات الضخمة، لتجربة مشاهدة متواصلة لعشّاق السينما.

events.description: ‫‫تحدث منعطفات غير متوقعة في قصة حياة سائق سيارة الأجرة شانموغان، إذ يتم وضع حبه لسيارته القديمة في الاختبار النهائي.‬‬
events.title: ثوداروم

events.description: ‫‫يقوم الرائد المفوض موكوند فاراداراجان الذي يترأس فوج راجبوت في الجيش الهندي بعملية عسكرية تنطوي على مكافحة الإرهاب أثناء انتشار قواته في جامو وكشمير.‬‬
events.title: أماران

events.description: ‫‫يعرف عن الشاب برابكاران هدوؤه واتباعه مبدأ غاندي المسالم، ولكنه عندما يرى أو يسمع أن أحدا ما قد ظلم، يقوم بالتحري والتصدي للجناة والمعتدين.‬‬
events.title: ساماسثاكيرالام بي.أو.

events.description: ‫‫بعد قراءة أحد الناشرين لأعمال من تأليف بالاتشاندران، يتشجع على نشر كتاب، لكنه يمر بضغوط نفسية، كما يواجه قفلة الكاتب.‬‬
events.title: Kayyoppu

events.description: ‫‫بالنسبة للمخرج التلفزيوني توماس كوتي باتشو، لا شيء أكثر إرهاقا من التعامل مع ابن عمه المزعج جوزيف كوفالان. لكن هذا يتغير عندما تحدث جريمة قتل في موقع التصوير.‬‬
events.title: باتشوفم كوفالينم

events.description: ‫‫يعيش مويدين وكانتشانامالا علاقة حب، لكنهما يدركان أن زواجهما مستحيل، إذ أن مويدين مسلم وكانتشانامالا ابنة رجل أرستقراطي هندوسي وصاحب أملاك.‬‬
events.title: إنو ننتي مويدين

events.description: ‫‫يصل فريق من رجال الشرطة المدربين حديثا من ولاية كيرلا الهندية بقيادة مساعد المفتش مانيكاندان إلى منطقة معرضة للحزب الماوي من أجل القيام بالانتخابات. يجب عليهم الدفاع عن أنفسهم من هجوم دون ذخيرة كافية.‬‬
events.title: أوندا

events.description: ‫‫يذهب سريكومار للقاء صديقه غوفيندان كوتي، إذ يلتقي في طريقه بفتاة تدعى نايانتارا ويعتقد في البداية أنها فتاة تمارس الرذيلة، إلا أنه يكتشف لاحقا أنها روح فتاة اختفت منذ فترة.‬‬
events.title: فيسميثومباثو

events.description: ‫‫يجبر العاشقان صوفي وسوجاتا على الانفصال بسبب ديانتهما. بعد سنوات، تتلقى سوجاتا مكالمة هاتفية تعيد الاتصال بين حياتيهما من جديد.‬‬
events.title: صوفيام سوجاتيام

events.description: ‫‫يحاول لص تهريب قلادة باهظة الثمن ويتعرف على فتاة بعد مشاجرة معها إلا أنه بعد ذلك يقع في حبها. تتشابك مصائرهما أثناء محاولتهما الوصول إلى وجهتهم النهائية.‬‬
events.title: فيتتم

events.description: ‫‫يكافح ماهيشوار لتربية ابنته مالو التي تبلغ من العمر خمس سنوات، والتي تحمله مسؤولية وفاة والدتها. تحاول غانغا إصلاح الخلاف بينهما.‬‬
events.title: مايامايورام

events.description: ‫‫تزور سيلاباثي برفقة والدتها قرية نائية، حيث تعمل مدرسة للحاسوب. يبدأ سكان القرية بإلقاء اللوم على حصتها التعليمية عندما يختفي بعض الطلاب بشكل غامض.‬‬
events.title: سيلاباثي

events.description: ‫‫يتم سجن ضابطة الخدمة الإدارية الهندية تشانتشالا ريدي في منزل مسكون للاستجواب. مع ذلك، تأخذ الأمور منعطفا غير متوقع عندما تصبح ممسوسة.‬‬
events.title: باغاماتي

events.description: ‫‫أربعة طلاب ينضمون إلى هيئة محاربة الفساد في مجال التعليم، ويثورون غضبا عندما تنتحر طالبة بسبب عدم تمكنها من الحصول على قرض دراسي.‬‬
events.title: باي ذا بيبول

events.description: ‫‫عندما تنطلق عائلة مكونة من أربعة أفراد في رحلة برية، ترافقهما اثنتان من الفتيات، لكن الأمور أخذت منعطفا غير متوقع عندما يعثر على إحدى الفتيات مقتولة.‬‬
events.title: أتشايانز

events.description: ‫‫يبحث الرجل الفقير ساتيا عن شقيقته التي اختطفها تجار بشر، لكن عملية زرع دماغ غير قانونية تضعه في مكان شخص ملياردير يدعى فيجاي.‬‬
events.title: بيتشكاران ٢

events.description: ‫‫يتم توظيف المخاطب التحفيزي فيجو ليكون وجها لعملية احتيال باسم الدين، إذ خضع فيجو لتدريب صارم من أجل هذا الهدف. مع ازدياد شعبيته، يغرق في أعماق الظلام والوهم.‬‬
events.title: ترانس

events.description: ‫‫ترغب الممرضة هيلين بالانتقال إلى كندا، لكن تأخذ الأمور منعطفا سيئا عندما لا تعود من عملها إلى المنزل وتختفي فجأة.‬‬
events.title: هيلين

events.description: ‫‫يرغب الصديقان المقربان جون وكوريان في جعل صداقتهما تتوطد أكثر من خلال تزويج ابنيهما لبعضهما البعض. مع ذلك، لا يدرك الأبوان شكل الحياة التي يعيشها ابناهما في المدينة.‬‬
events.title: برو دادي

events.description: ‫‫تتغير حياة مذيع الأخبار المكافح إنغلز راماسوامي وعائلته عندما تظهر أمامهم إلهة. لاحقا، وبمساعدة الإلهة، ينطلق إنغلز لكشف رجال الدين المزيفين.‬‬
events.title: موكوثي أمان

events.description: ‫‫تؤدي فرقة كالادارشانا عرضا فنيا داخل السجن حيث يهاجمهم أحد النزلاء الناقمين، غير أن أعضاء الفرقة يجدون أنفسهم المتهمين الرئيسيين عندما يعثر على النزيل مقتولا.‬‬
events.title: أغين كاسارغود قادر بهاي

events.description: ‫‫تخطط وريثة ثرية لتوريط حبيبها السابق في جريمة قتلها من خلال الاستعانة بقاتل مأجور، ولكن تأخذ الأمور منعطفا آخر عندما يدخل لص إلى المنزل في نفس توقيت الجريمة.‬‬
events.title: إيديتس

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the R&B quintet FROM ALL TO HUMAN! Composed of vocalist Blesssing guitarist PARK JAE WOO bassist NAM WOO SEOK keyboardist MOON SUNG HWAN and drummer MOON SEONG HO this band brought a new wave of R&B to the Korean music scene upon their debut in 2017. With their band's name referring to a journey “from all beings to humans” the five hope to develop every day as musicians. True to their name they are evolving and developing every day winning the Grand Prize at the 2019 Shinhan Card Rookie Project and the TOP2 at KT&G’s SangSang Madang Band Discovery Competition in 2019. From acid jazz to R&B to new jack swing the quintet covers a wide range of genres in their music backed up by solid storylines which makes them truly one of a kind. In this episode FROM ALL TO HUMAN performs Dizzy Oriental chill Don't be disappointed and more to showcase the quintessence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five genuine musicians!
events.title: I'M LIVE - FROM ALL TO HUMAN

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the city pop band ADOY! Composed of vocalist and guitarist Oh Juhwan keyboardist Zee bassist Jung Dayoung and drummer Park Geunchang this quartet burst onto the music scene in 2017 with the EP CATNIP. Thanks to the success of Grace and San Francisco from the EP they topped the K-Indie Chart and became nominated for Best Modern Rock at the prestigious Korean Music Awards in 2018. Then in the following year they won Judges' Prize at the Seoul Music Awards creating a new flow of Korean city pop. ADOY's music has a special power. Iit fills the city with romantic vibes instantly and also transforms city noises into sophisticated tunes. What's more their music has mass appeal yet it is unique. So now the quartet itself is a genre that mesmerizes not only Korean listeners but also the world. Last month ADOY released their new EP her to display their ever-evolving artistry and the quartet is here to perform their latest tracks including Simply Antihero Baby and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet ADOY!
events.title: I'M LIVE - ADOY

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kim Jae-hyung! Kim Jae-hyung is a self-taught guitarist who picked up the guitar when he was serving in the NAVY as a secretary for the naval military band. He continued playing the instrument after his discharge and had the first public performance in 2013 at an unplugged open mic night. Then in 2017 he released his first EP CIRCUS. Three years later he presented his first full-length album Flex which was nominated for Best Folk Album at the 2021 Korean Music Awards and the lead single Failure Story was nominated for Best Folk Song. Kim Jae-hyung is also known for covering a wide spectrum of music. Recently he came up with a new single titled Addiction with danceable vibes. Constantly pushing his musical boundaries this artist definitely makes us look forward to his future moves. In this episode Kim Jae-hyung performs Addiction Failure Story More Doubt and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!
events.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Jae-hyung

The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter YEGNY formerly known as Choi Ye-geun! This artist first became known in 2012 as the genius keyboardist in an audition program titled K-pop Star - Season 2. Since then she has actively pursued her career as a musician releasing a number of singles and working with other top-notch musicians including AKMU. Last year YEGNY released her first full-length album Even If Get Lost It Can Flow Anyway and shared with the public her concerns as a musician and self-reflection as well as her view on human relationships and social issues. With the song Better Rush (feat. Huckleberry P) she changed her stage name to YEGNY to mark a new beginning as an artist. In this episode YEGNY performs Better Rush I know Lucid dream and Unbalance as well as her cover of Better by BoA and Irony by Wonder Girls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out all that YEGNY has to show off!
events.title: I'M LIVE - YEGNY

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter ARO! ARO burst into the music scene in July 2018 with the single A Good Daughter. Her stage name means engraving in Korean which conveys her hope to engrave her name in the minds of the public. She's also known for her ability to express common relatable issues in her own unique way deeply touching and soothing listeners' hearts. Sentimental at times yet unpredictable at others she's definitely engraving her name in our hearts. In this episode ARO performs SEESAW When The Night Comes Day 1 Why Did You Answer? and also her cover of Delispice's Confession. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!
events.title: I'M LIVE - ARO

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the hottest newtro master PARKMOONCHI! PARKMOONCHI became known to the public through the variety show Hangout with Yoo where she displayed her exceptional ability to put her own contemporary spin to 1990s music. That sensational appearance led her to actively collaborate with numerous big names in the music scene including Suho and Baekhyun from EXO Kang Daniel Kwon Jin Ah and Young K from Day6. Also known for her witty and unexpectional point of view PARKMOONCHI shares with everyone how the Generagion MZ enjoys the music and culture of older generations - no wonder how she became an icon of MZers. In September this year PARKMOONCHI released a new EP named ParkRuRa with RuRu and RaRa. Combining R&B new jack swing and soul music the three musicians also known as PARKMOONCHI UNIVERSE show off their unique yet beautiful universe under their motto Pursuing joy and happiness together In this episode PARKMOONCHI performs m e s s a g e . . . and Move! from the album ParkRuRa her cover of Lee Ye-rin's Come On Baby Tonight as well as I Want To Hold Your Hand and The Story Of The Year with Onewoo. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this delightful and unpredicted artist!

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is talented vocalist BAEK A YEON! Known for her crystal clear voice BAEK A YEON made her big debut in 2012 after making it to the top three of the popular talent search show K-Pop Star in 2011. Then she dominated the top spots of various music charts and shows with the song Shouldn't Have... which she wrote at the end of a disappointing relationship. After that she released more songs about love oftentimes unrequited love including Looking For Love and so-so which has eventually become her own genre. In this episode BAEK A YEON performs Shouldn't Have... so-so Sweet Lies a Good Boy Jealousy and 0% the lead single off her latest album Observe. Tune in to I'm LIVE and fall in love with her crystalline voice once again!
events.title: I'M LIVE - BAEK A YEON

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter eldon! This artist became known to the public after taking part in the TV program Superstar K Season 7 where he made it to the top 5. Then in 2016 he officially made his debut as the vocalist of Martin Smith and once again surprised the public with his rhythmical vibes and songwriting skills. 2 years later in 2018 he started his career as a solo artist under his new stage name eldon. From his debut single Ghost! to Pink cheeks to Do monsters love too? he has already released an impressive set of albums which are full of his personal feelings and experiences. Also Pink cheeks was featured in the hit TV series My Roommate Is a Gumiho and widened his reach in the industry. In this episode eldon performs Pink cheeks Back to you and more to show off his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet eldon!
events.title: I'M LIVE - eldon

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are four guys performing under the slogan of “chaotic world warm music” - it's Nerd Connection! This band is composed of four graduates of Yonsei University one of the most prestigious universities in Korea. The beginning was almost accidental - Vocalist Seo Yeong-ju and guitarist Choi Seung-won began performing together in 2012 as part of the university’s rock band club Medusa. Then bassist Park Jae-hyun and drummer Shin Yeon-tae joined the band and they made their step into the professional music scene with their first single Hymn of the Birds in 2018. The same year they took part in the Emergenza Festival the world's largest festival for unsigned bands. After several regional qualifiers in Korea they passed the Korean qualification which led to the finals at a festival in Germany. With that unbelievable milestone at the very beginning stages of their career the four have pleasantly surprised listeners both at home and abroad until now. In October this year Nerd Connection released their first full-length album. All 12 songs in the album are tied under the concept of nostalgia for things gone by touching listeners in their unique way. In this episode the quartet performs 21st Century Kingdom Hollywood Movie Star Waterfall Bamboo Forest and Good Night Good Dream. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the four highly talented musicians!
events.title: I'M LIVE - Nerd Connection

events.description: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a band hoping to touch your heart - Touched! Touched is a quintet composed of guitarist D.on drummer Seung bin Kim vocalist and guitarist YunMin bassist John B.Kim and keyboardist Chae Dohyeon who are all graduates of Seoul Institute of the Arts. They are young as a band but they already have an impressive award-winning career. They won the Grand Prize at the 31st Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest in 2020 as the first band in the contest's history the Grand Prize at the 2021 Pyeongtaek National Band Comepetition the Grand Prize at the Hwaseong City Culture Foundation - RISING STAR 4U and another Grand Prize at the Gyeonggi Content Agency Indiestance. Having won three grand prizes in 2021 alone Touched is considered one of the hottest rookie bands in the Korean music scene. Also combining their intense rock energy with sensitive emotional modern rock the quintet is actively pushing their boundaries creating their own genre. In this episode Touched performs The Dawn Star Hi Bully Call Me Love is Dangerous and their cover of Blue which led them to win the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae Ha Music Contest. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five talented artists!
events.title: I'M LIVE - Touched

events.description: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.
events.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes

events.description: Xiamen, a key starting point of China’s ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China’s most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Explore Xiamen University, renowned as China’s most beautiful university campus, and visit Wanshi Park, known as “China’s First Lawn”. Trace Xiamen’s history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city’s early commercial development. Finally, board a boat to Gulangyu Islet, the “Island of Music” — the birthplace of modern music education in China, and a living “World Architecture Museum”. Every corner of this islet lets you experience the past and present of Xiamen’s vibrant life.
events.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems

events.description:
Yuxian County in Zhangjiakou, north China's Hebei Province is home to numerous national-level cultural heritage sites. The Yuhuang Pavilion, constructed in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644), once served as a frontier defense structure and later served as an architectural reference for the hit game Black Myth: Wukong. Meanwhile, Yuxian paper-cutting, which originated as window decorations for rural homes, has evolved for over a century into a distinctive form of cultural expression that has reached audiences around the world.
CGTN host Julian Waghann and Mexican traveler Juan Carlos Cheang Guzman toured Yuxian, discovering the stories behind its ancient architecture and learning the art of paper-cutting. As local craftspeople and communities keep these traditions alive, Yuxian shows how ancient culture can continue to evolve, connect with new generations and reach the world in new ways.
events.title: Yuxian, a living legacy of ancient architecture and paper-cutting

events.description:
Yuxian County in Zhangjiakou, north China's Hebei Province is home to numerous national-level cultural heritage sites. The Yuhuang Pavilion, constructed in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644), once served as a frontier defense structure and later served as an architectural reference for the hit game Black Myth: Wukong. Meanwhile, Yuxian paper-cutting, which originated as window decorations for rural homes, has evolved for over a century into a distinctive form of cultural expression that has reached audiences around the world.
CGTN host Julian Waghann and Mexican traveler Juan Carlos Cheang Guzman toured Yuxian, discovering the stories behind its ancient architecture and learning the art of paper-cutting. As local craftspeople and communities keep these traditions alive, Yuxian shows how ancient culture can continue to evolve, connect with new generations and reach the world in new ways.
events.title: Yuxian, a living legacy of ancient architecture and paper-cutting

events.description: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran He in experiencing the unique culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. We'll explore everything from Haikou's winding alleys and mangrove forests, to the culture of its southeast Asian diaspora, so come and discover this magical destination with us.

events.description: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

events.description: This ten-part documentary introduces the food of Yunnan, from the opening chapters "Family Feast in Spring" and "Simple Joys" to the nostalgic "Times Past" and "Love Away from Home." While each chapter seems to stand alone, they share a common core. Unlike conventional food documentaries, The Taste of Yunnan leaps across the region and avoids categorizing by locality or dish. Instead, every episode follows its own protagonists: the Zheng Hongwei brothers harvesting water bamboo shoots in Jianshui; Yang Jimei's family gathering toon sprouts at the foot of Jizu Mountain in Binchuan, Dali; and Wang Jinghua, a young man of the Nu ethnic group who still makes the traditional Nujiang dish "chicken cooked in lacquer tree oil" entirely by hand. Through its plain yet detailed portrayal of food and its subtle understanding of the relationship between people and ingredients, the series is much more than a food documentary. It challenges the old misperception that Yunnan cuisine lacks cultural depth, showing that its heritage is humble and simple - found in a piece of Heqing's secret-recipe blown liver from Dali, or in a jar of Yinji pickles from Weishan.
events.title: The Taste of Yunnan Ep.1

events.description:
The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature.
Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint.
A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.
events.title: Fujian's Tulou - The Mysterious Earthen Castles

events.description: In the second episode of our Xiamen series, host Tianran He and co-host Laura, an American who has lived in Xiamen for 7 years, guide you to discover Xiamen's internationalization, modernization, and unique fashion vibe. First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan — once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub — to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen’s fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.
events.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewels

events.description: This ten-part documentary introduces the food of Yunnan, from the opening chapters "Family Feast in Spring" and "Simple Joys" to the nostalgic "Times Past" and "Love Away from Home." While each chapter seems to stand alone, they share a common core. Unlike conventional food documentaries, The Taste of Yunnan leaps across the region and avoids categorizing by locality or dish. Instead, every episode follows its own protagonists: the Zheng Hongwei brothers harvesting water bamboo shoots in Jianshui; Yang Jimei's family gathering toon sprouts at the foot of Jizu Mountain in Binchuan, Dali; and Wang Jinghua, a young man of the Nu ethnic group who still makes the traditional Nujiang dish "chicken cooked in lacquer tree oil" entirely by hand. Through its plain yet detailed portrayal of food and its subtle understanding of the relationship between people and ingredients, the series is much more than a food documentary. It challenges the old misperception that Yunnan cuisine lacks cultural depth, showing that its heritage is humble and simple - found in a piece of Heqing's secret-recipe blown liver from Dali, or in a jar of Yinji pickles from Weishan.
events.title: The Taste of Yunnan Ep.1

events.description:
The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature.
Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint.
A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.
events.title: Fujian's Tulou - The Mysterious Earthen Castles

events.description: In the second episode of our Xiamen series, host Tianran He and co-host Laura, an American who has lived in Xiamen for 7 years, guide you to discover Xiamen's internationalization, modernization, and unique fashion vibe. First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan — once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub — to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen’s fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.
events.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewels

events.description: In the second episode of our Xiamen series, host Tianran He and co-host Laura, an American who has lived in Xiamen for 7 years, guide you to discover Xiamen's internationalization, modernization, and unique fashion vibe. First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan — once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub — to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen’s fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.
events.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewels

events.description: Xizang Rhapsody spotlights motivated young people across different fields in Xizang who follow their passion and defy preconceived notions about life there. Among them are Tashi Tsering, who pioneered Tibetan-language versions of globally popular children’s books; "Wootsang Dance Crew," the first street dance crew in Xizang; Tsomo, the region's first certified international coffee taster and founder of a "highland coffee lab;" electronic music lover Thubten Tenzin Chosphel; modern dancer Sonam Droma; and some of the first skateboarders in Lhasa. Told through their individual stories and viewpoints, the film reveals how tradition and modernity interact, and reflects Xizang's social progress and growing cultural diversity.
events.title: Xizang Rhapsody

events.description: Bobby, aka Lin Ziguan, is a passionate young climber in Wenzhou City, east China's Zhejiang Province. He first came across the sport when his parents took him to an indoor climbing facility at a local shopping mall for fun, and it was a case of love at first sight. To further fuel his passion, Bobby's father refurnished a room at home and turned it into a private rock-climbing gym. While many students find themselves "climbing the walls" with frustration on weeknights and grumbling at their homework, Bobby spends most of his free time clambering around the surfaces of his bedroom as he aspires to become a celebrated outdoor rock climber one day.
events.title: Born to climb

events.description: This ten-part documentary introduces the food of Yunnan, from the opening chapters "Family Feast in Spring" and "Simple Joys" to the nostalgic "Times Past" and "Love Away from Home." While each chapter seems to stand alone, they share a common core. Unlike conventional food documentaries, The Taste of Yunnan leaps across the region and avoids categorizing by locality or dish. Instead, every episode follows its own protagonists: the Zheng Hongwei brothers harvesting water bamboo shoots in Jianshui; Yang Jimei's family gathering toon sprouts at the foot of Jizu Mountain in Binchuan, Dali; and Wang Jinghua, a young man of the Nu ethnic group who still makes the traditional Nujiang dish "chicken cooked in lacquer tree oil" entirely by hand. Through its plain yet detailed portrayal of food and its subtle understanding of the relationship between people and ingredients, the series is much more than a food documentary. It challenges the old misperception that Yunnan cuisine lacks cultural depth, showing that its heritage is humble and simple - found in a piece of Heqing's secret-recipe blown liver from Dali, or in a jar of Yinji pickles from Weishan.
events.title: The Taste of Yunnan Ep.1

events.description: Bobby, aka Lin Ziguan, is a passionate young climber in Wenzhou City, east China's Zhejiang Province. He first came across the sport when his parents took him to an indoor climbing facility at a local shopping mall for fun, and it was a case of love at first sight. To further fuel his passion, Bobby's father refurnished a room at home and turned it into a private rock-climbing gym. While many students find themselves "climbing the walls" with frustration on weeknights and grumbling at their homework, Bobby spends most of his free time clambering around the surfaces of his bedroom as he aspires to become a celebrated outdoor rock climber one day.
events.title: Born to climb

events.description: This ten-part documentary introduces the food of Yunnan, from the opening chapters "Family Feast in Spring" and "Simple Joys" to the nostalgic "Times Past" and "Love Away from Home." While each chapter seems to stand alone, they share a common core. Unlike conventional food documentaries, The Taste of Yunnan leaps across the region and avoids categorizing by locality or dish. Instead, every episode follows its own protagonists: the Zheng Hongwei brothers harvesting water bamboo shoots in Jianshui; Yang Jimei's family gathering toon sprouts at the foot of Jizu Mountain in Binchuan, Dali; and Wang Jinghua, a young man of the Nu ethnic group who still makes the traditional Nujiang dish "chicken cooked in lacquer tree oil" entirely by hand. Through its plain yet detailed portrayal of food and its subtle understanding of the relationship between people and ingredients, the series is much more than a food documentary. It challenges the old misperception that Yunnan cuisine lacks cultural depth, showing that its heritage is humble and simple - found in a piece of Heqing's secret-recipe blown liver from Dali, or in a jar of Yinji pickles from Weishan.
events.title: The Taste of Yunnan Ep.3

events.description: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.
events.title: China Bound: Wuhan

events.description:
In the third episode of our Xiamen series, we introduce four expats from BRICS countries and their inspiring lives in Xiamen.
Bjorn, from South Africa, is deeply passionate about Chinese food culture and architecture, and is even skilled at oracle bone script calligraphy. Living in Shapowei, Xiamen’s busiest creative district, he knows every street and lane intimately, and has a profound love for the city's charm.
Atul Verma, a yoga teacher from India, opened a yoga studio in Xiamen and built a new career here. Surrounded by Xiamen's peaceful Buddhist atmosphere, he has found a true sense of home in this foreign land.
Juan Guimaraes, from Brazil, is an international freshman studying medicine at Xiamen University. Filled with curiosity and longing for both the campus and the city, he hopes to live a fulfilling life at the university and fall in love with Xiamen.
Rustam Apushev, from Russia, is known to everyone as a loving “super dad”, but his true identity is a former boxing champion with countless championship medals. He met his wife in Xiamen, raised two children, founded his own school, and started a whole new life. “Xiamen is my home,” he says."
events.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.3

events.description: It was a deep and long-standing fascination with Eastern culture that led Jake Pinnick on a fantastic journey – all the way from the U.S. to Wudang Mountain in China. Once there, he submerged himself completely in Wudang martial arts, drawing spiritual nourishment from Daoist wisdom. Over the years, he transformed from a novice martial arts enthusiast to an inheritor of an entire tradition! But now that the mantle is around Jake's shoulders, it's time for him to consider how to pass the Wudang tradition on and share traditional Chinese Daoist philosophy with people from around the world.
events.title: Jake Pinnick’s Transformation My Journey as a Daoist Priest in Wudang

The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

events.description: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.
events.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic

events.description: Muqam is a performing art with its roots in the folklore of Xinjiang. Rather like an encyclopedia, Muqam is a record of the history and lifestyle of the local Uygur people. It originated in folk culture, with lyrics that covered everything from philosophical aphorisms to folk tales. Muqam is a vehicle for Uygur people to express their feelings and ideas. As such, it is an integral part of Xinjiang culture - and even the culture of the Silk Road. In the episode, the host travels around the Kashgar area, learning about the history and art of Muqam.

events.description: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person's body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction - be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.
events.title: The Story of Flying Trident

events.description:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

events.description: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

events.description: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

events.description: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.
